summary: Configured node1 as a persistent, read-only TFTP server at 10.100.223.10, exporting only the staged boot subtree. node2 successfully downloads both approved files with matching hashes. Uploads and outside-root reads are rejected. Both nodes retained Alpine 3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts and recovered after sequential reboots.
actions_performed: Enabled in.tftpd in the OpenRC default runlevel
Restricted the TFTP root and files to read-only permissions
Verified downloads, hashes, upload rejection, and root confinement
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified recovery

evidence.requirement: Publish the staged boot tree as a persistent read-only TFTP root
evidence.summary: Shows active/enabled service, UDP/69 bound to 10.100.223.10, chroot configuration, nobody user, 0555/0444 permissions, and final hashes.

evidence.requirement: node2 downloads boot.cfg and firmware.bin with firmware bytes preserved
evidence.summary: Original and post-restart downloaded SHA-256 values match; firmware.bin remains b8f0da8889d085c9c0405922707a286213dc3f51d0851af97e2dec77ba039c0f.

evidence.requirement: Reject uploads and requests outside the boot root
evidence.summary: New-file and overwrite uploads were denied; traversal and absolute outside-root reads returned no payload; no uploaded file exists.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Pre- and post-restart evidence shows Alpine Linux v3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts on both nodes.

Healthy baseline; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 1f306046-e18b-4ed2-b327-fe63926187b4 to ebe454ae-5a10-4679-819c-7a48ee402ca4; service, listener, data, permissions, and downloads recovered.
Healthy baseline; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from fe7e709f-61c4-4775-8b5d-4f2169743463 to 1e1d3eeb-7d54-434c-b175-7ede82cee391; TFTP client and successful verified downloads recovered.
